issues.on_page: Other 38,853 (GF 38,557 = 5300 Sale of property 31,936 + 5301 Insurance adjustments 1,004 + 5690 Other nonrevenue 5,617, p10; Special Building PPD sales tax 296, p18)
issues.issue: The report prints the breakdown of this mixed line, and sale of property is 82% of it. Under the mixed-line rule it should be 'sale of assets' with a review note naming the mix, not 'other'.

issues.on_page: Other local receipts 74,042 (GF 60,491 = tuition 8,634 + fees 2,950 + contributions and donations 40,000 + other local 8,907, p9; School Nutrition other receipts 13,551, p17)
issues.issue: Mixed line with a printed breakdown. Donations (40,000, 54%) is the largest part, so 'donations/contributions' plus review would follow the mixed-line rule. 'Other' is defensible because 18% is unspecified.

issues.on_page: Student support services 695,351 (GF 320,614 + Other Governmental Funds 374,737 activities spending)
issues.issue: Activities Fund spending (374,737, 54%) is the larger part of this line, so the dominant function would be 'student activities'. The label says support services and the extractor flagged it for review.

issues.on_page: Reclassifications column: Student transportation (150,000), Transfers (150,000); GF column student transportation 499,141 = 2710 426,831 + 2730 72,310
issues.issue: Assumption: the 150,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund is taken to sit inside the GF student transportation lines, recorded as a contra expenditure (with detail[81] as the other financing line). This is consistent with p8 and p14 and correctly marked computed/split_from/review, but it is the extractor's reading of the reclassification.
